header.slogan: Software, Done Right — For Every Platform

hero.description: I'm a Developer passionate about building polished, high-performance tools and apps. Specialized in Website, Tool, and Cross-Platform App development.

philosophy.title: Development Philosophy
philosophy.desc: Every line of code matters. I don't just write software that runs; I build systems that are optimized, stable, and aesthetically refined. Whether it's a macOS system tool or a demanding Android app, simplicity and user experience are always the guiding principles.

edge.title: Competitive Edge
edge.desc: Mastering System-level, Native Apps, and Web Frontend. Instead of patchwork solutions, I focus on solid architecture, latency optimization, and strict adherence to each OS's UI/UX standards (Apple Human Interface & Google Material).

stack.title: Tech Stack & Tools
stack.desc: Leveraging modern and Native technologies to ensure maximum performance across platforms.

services.title: Services
services.lead: I help teams and startups turn ideas into shippable, maintainable products.

items.title: Mobile Development
items.outcome: Smooth apps, OS-design compliant, fast releases.

items.title: Desktop Development
items.desc: macOS (SwiftUI/AppKit), Windows (WinUI/WPF), Linux (GTK/Qt). Tauri/Electron for cross-platform.
items.outcome: System tools, productivity apps running native.

items.title: Cross-Platform Architecture
items.desc: Kotlin Multiplatform, Flutter, React Native, Tauri. Shared business logic, native UI per platform.
items.outcome: One logic codebase, multiple platform UIs.

items.title: Architecture & Performance
items.desc: Clean architecture, offline-first, startup optimization, memory profiling, CI/CD setup.

items.title: Code Review & Mentoring
items.desc: PR audits, CI/CD pipelines, team velocity improvement, best practices coaching.
items.outcome: Clean codebase, autonomous team, faster shipping.

items.title: Technical Advisory
items.desc: Stack selection, feasibility studies, project rescue, due diligence.
items.outcome: Right technical decisions, reduced risk, cost savings.

contactSection.title: Have a product that needs to be done right?
contactSection.lead: Share a few details about the problem, platforms, and timeline. I will come back with a clear, practical direction.

cta.description: Download and start using the product today. Built to be fast, stable, and thoughtfully designed.
cta.supportHint: If the product is useful, you can support T-Dev Studio to continue maintaining and developing.
